question: Should ClawHub make the current public catalog feed fail closed on missing signing configuration and redirect oversized skills consumers to signed shard roots before the matching OpenClaw consumer rollout is merged?
rationale: The patch creates a new public protocol and intentionally changes established endpoint behavior during an operator-managed signing-key rollout; maintainer intent is required to choose the compatibility and activation policy.

options.title: Stage signed delivery behind compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing atomic endpoint available until production signing configuration and compatible consumers are verified, then activate shard-root delivery in a coordinated rollout.

options.title: Require signing immediately
options.body: Accept that an unconfigured deployment returns `503` and that oversized legacy skills consumers must upgrade to follow signed shard roots.

options.title: Split the protocol rollout
options.body: Land only independently safe storage/schema preparation now and defer public-route activation until the consumer and key-distribution plan are approved.

recommendation.title: Stage signed delivery behind compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the existing atomic endpoint available until production signing configuration and compatible consumers are verified, then activate shard-root delivery in a coordinated rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked producer-side protocol stack and can supply the intended rollout and consumer coordination context.
